issues.description: Default base image string duplicated in three places — Python, TypeScript constant, TypeScript fallback
issues.detail: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE = 'python:3.12' is defined in backend/kale/pipeline.py, then hardcoded again as a constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and again as a literal fallback in Commands.ts getDefaultBaseImage. The whole point of the RPC is to make this single-sourced. Next bump to python:3.13 will silently leave two stale copies. Either trust the RPC or don't add it.

issues.description: Silent behavior change: empty base_image fallback now ships python:3.12 instead of kfp default
issues.detail: _set_base_image previously set self.base_image = "" when pod introspection failed, letting kfp pick its own default. Now it pins python:3.12. That is a real runtime behavior change for every user whose pod-image lookup fails, not a UI cosmetic. Commit message says 'display' — the diff does more. THREE-PATCHES: split UI from semantics.

issues.description: Button width:'5%' with text 'IMAGE' is the wrong shape for replacing a text Input
issues.detail: The old UI was an Input field where you typed the image. The new UI is a 5%-wide button labeled IMAGE that opens a modal. You also dropped Input width from 35% to 30% with no explanation. This is a UX regression dressed as a feature — extra click for the common case of editing the image. BAD-TASTE.

issues.description: RPC round-trip for a compile-time constant is gratuitous
issues.detail: get_default_base_image is an RPC that returns a string literal defined in Python source. The labextension calls it on every panel init, with try/catch and a hardcoded fallback. A build-time inject or a single bundled constants endpoint would do. You added a network call to read a constant, then hardcoded the same constant as a fallback. Pick one.

issues.description: InlineMetadata now always renders the Base Image line, including for non-step cells
issues.detail: createBaseImageText() used to return '' when no baseImage was set. Now it unconditionally renders 'Base Image: <default> (default)'. The caller doesn't gate it by cellType, so imports/functions/skip cells may now display a meaningless base image. Verify the caller path — if it does gate, fine; if not, this is visual noise on every non-step cell.

issues.description: Local import of DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE inside function body
issues.detail: get_default_base_image does `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the function. There is no circular-import reason given; nb.py already imports from kale elsewhere. Move it to the top of the module with the other imports. Style nit, but it's the codebase's own convention.

review.summary: NEEDS-WORK. This was sold as a display feature but it changes runtime behavior in pipeline.py (empty-string fallback → pinned python:3.12) and ships the constant in three places that will drift. That's THREE-PATCHES at minimum: (1) define DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE once and plumb it through, (2) UI to show it, (3) the semantic change to _set_base_image — and that third one deserves its own discussion, not a piggyback. The IMAGE button replacing an inline Input is also a UX regression. Fix the duplication, split the semantic change out, and reconsider whether a button-plus-modal is really better than the field that was there.
